Welcome to Dr. Loc VetLife! 🩺🌾

I am a professional large animal veterinarian based in Vietnam, specializing in cattle care, livestock health management, and reproductive assistance. 

On this channel, I want to share my real-life daily farm calls and expert veterinary practices. You will see intense field work, satisfying hoof trimming procedures, abscess treatments, and emergency cattle rescues. Every video is a real story of helping farm animals walk pain-free and stay healthy.

If you love animals and enjoy watching real, satisfying veterinary work, you are in the right place!

👉 Subscribe to follow my daily journey!
📩 Contact for work: vanlochoaky@gmail.com
